## Problem Statement
Describe the workflow pain point or gap you are trying to solve.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the behavior, UI interaction, API route, or Chromium patch you envision.

## Scope
- [ ] Desktop Manager UI / UX
- [ ] Proxy / Routing Engine (`Xray` / `Mihomo`)
- [ ] Fingerprint-Chromium Patch Stack (`chromium-patches/v158/`)
- [ ] Mod SDK / Extension Slots
- [ ] Local HTTP Automation API
- [ ] Cross-Platform Build / Packaging

## Security & Privacy Considerations
Does this feature introduce new network requests, file I/O, or permissions? Confirm how it stays aligned with Aether Nebula's offline-first and Vault-only design.

## Alternatives Considered
Any workarounds or alternative designs you considered (e.g., implementing it as a pluggable Mod instead of modifying core).
